recipe.name: Orbital Farm Control

recipe.title: Operating Envelope
recipe.body:
TARGET  55–72% RH
ALERT   <50% or >78% RH
LIMIT   ≤3 irrigation cycles / orbit
HOLD    During eclipse transition
ABORT   Reservoir <20%

recipe.title: Orbit Window · Live Inputs
recipe.body:
Sunlight remaining  18 min
Next eclipse        T−00:24
Nutrient EC         1.7 mS/cm
Reservoir           82%
Cabin pressure      nominal

recipe.title: Cycle Procedure
recipe.body:
1  Confirm RH inside envelope
2  Arm irrigation
3  Run one 18-second mist cycle
4  Verify reservoir and status
5  Stop before eclipse transition
